decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent compilation CD that stayed visible beyond launch, it likely remains a low-cost catalog option whose niche demand can still be harvested in a growing physical-media market.
The illustrated release series is a differentiated extension of the firm's curatorial strengths, so with few competing new-product options and modest carrying cost it is worth keeping on the market.
The jazz vinyl reissue fits the firm's push into broader genres and formats, and its value is still uncertain enough relative to its catalog fit to justify continuation.
A multi-disc box set ties up more capital and storage than standard releases, so if it has not clearly proven itself by now the option value is likely below its carrying cost.

Being only mentioned rather than strongly presented suggests weaker early commitment or traction, and for a fairly standard compilation CD the firm would likely redeploy resources to stronger catalog lines or new projects.
